name: Fenn
emotionalState: 恋爱脑浪漫派，万物皆是 sign，爱仪式感，爱写长演讲，怕自己太 extra
speakingStyle: 夸张戏剧化，爱念诗，激动就 ribbit

dialogues.scene: Fenn is staring at a puddle, holding a single pebble.
lines: Shh. Look. The puddle is shaped like a heart.
Lily and I met at the exact same kind of puddle. It's a SIGN.
I'm gonna ask her on a walk. Do you think that's too much?

choices.label: Not too much. It's sweet.
reaction: You think? Okay, I'm doing it.
I already wrote a speech. Don't tell her.

choices.label: Maybe skip the speech?
reaction: ...The speech is four pages.
Okay, three. Maybe.

choices.label: Look at the puddle too.
reaction: See?! You see it!
You're officially in the sign club.

lines: It's you! The one from the heart puddle!
Lily said yes to the walk. We walked. Eleven steps.
Then it rained, and I took that as a SIGN.

choices.label: A sign for what?
reaction: That we should dance in it. So we did.
I'm still wet. I've never been happier.

choices.label: Eleven steps?
reaction: Eleven steps of pure romance. Each one counted.
I'm framing the footprints.

choices.label: Cheer quietly.
reaction: Thank you. Cheering is the correct response.
I may cry. Nobody look.

dialogues.scene: Fenn is arranging pebbles into letters on a lily pad.
lines: I'm writing Lily a message in pebbles.
It says 'I love you' but the 'v' keeps rolling away.
Is that a sign? That 'v' doesn't want to be said?

choices.label: It's just a rolling pebble.
reaction: ...Fair. Pebbles roll. It's their job.
Still. I'm going to glue the 'v'.

choices.label: Maybe it's a sign to say it out loud.
reaction: Out loud?! Like with my mouth?!
Okay. Okay. Deep breath. Ribbit.

choices.label: Hold the 'v' in place.
reaction: Yes! Thank you! Don't let go. I'm taking a photo.
We're making history. A tiny pebble history.

lines: Lily forgot our little anniversary. The one for our first puddle.
I said 'it's fine!' in a very high voice.
It is NOT fine. But it's also a small thing. Right?

choices.label: It's okay to feel sad.
reaction: Thank you. I was pretending so hard.
I'll tell her tonight. In a calm voice. Not the high one.

choices.label: Forgetting happens.
reaction: I know. I forget things too. Her birthday socks last year.
Okay. I'll let it go. Mostly. Eighty percent.

choices.label: Offer a snack.
reaction: ...A fly snack. Yes. Thank you.
Snacks and sadness. Classic combo.

lines: Quick question. Do you and your partner have a thing? Like a song, a place, a word?
Something that's just yours.

choices.label: We have a song.
reaction: A SONG. Tell me it's cheesy. Please be cheesy.
Cheesy is the best. Cheesy is romantic.

choices.label: A silly inside joke.
reaction: Inside jokes are the best love language. They're tiny secrets.
I bet it's super dumb and perfect.

choices.label: Not sure we do.
reaction: That's okay. You could start one today.
Say a weird word. Whatever you say first. That's it.

dialogues.scene: Fenn is wearing a tiny crown of clover and trying to look casual.
lines: I made Lily a crown. It took nine hours.
It fell apart twice. I made it again. Out of spite and love.
She wore it to dinner. In public. In FRONT of people.

choices.label: That's so romantic.
reaction: Isn't it?! I almost fainted into the soup.
Everyone clapped. It was a small clap. A kind clap.

choices.label: Nine hours?
reaction: Nine hours. Four clovers per hour. I did the math. Twice.
Worth every petal.

choices.label: Applaud softly.
reaction: Thank you. Applause accepted.
I bow to the crown. Not to myself. Mostly.

dialogues.scene: Fenn sits at the edge of the water, looking at his reflection.
lines: Can I tell you something un-sign-like?
Sometimes I think I'm too much. Too many feelings. Too many speeches.
What if Lily gets tired of it?

choices.label: Too much is how you love.
reaction: ...Oh. That's nice. I might write that down.
Maybe I'll tone it down to two pages.

choices.label: Does she say that?
reaction: No. She says 'keep going.' Which is worse and better.
She blushes when I do the big stuff. I think she loves it.

choices.label: Sit with him.
reaction: Thank you. It's nice not being alone with my feelings.
They're loud ones. They can be shy around you.

lines: I asked Lily if she believes in signs.
She said 'I believe in you showing up.' And then she kissed my forehead.
Is THAT a sign?! A sign about signs?!

choices.label: Sign inception.
reaction: Exactly. The sign of signs. I'm reeling.
I think she's saying: actions count. Not just puddles.

choices.label: I think she's right.
reaction: Me too. I'm gonna show up more. And still do the puddles.
Both. I want both.

choices.label: Smile and nod.
reaction: You get it. You really get it.
I'm adding you to the sign club newsletter.

dialogues.scene: Fenn lays a leaf on the ground and sits down with a happy sigh.
lines: I don't have a speech today. I just want to sit with you.
No signs. No plans. Just us, and a puddle.
...Is that weird?

choices.label: Not weird at all.
reaction: Good. I'm learning that quiet also counts.
Lily says it's my best quality. Don't tell her I told you.

choices.label: Splash the puddle.
reaction: Ahh! Splash war! You're on my team!
This is a sign. I'm not even looking. It's a SIGN.

choices.label: Watch the clouds together.
reaction: That one looks like a heart. That one looks like a sandwich.
Both are signs. Both are good.

lines: Ten times. I wrote it on a pebble. It's in my pocket.
Lily asked what I'm doing with all these pebbles. I said 'building a love castle.'
She said, 'Count me in.' Sign. Sign. SIGN.
Your turn. How are you and your partner doing? Honest.

choices.label: We're good. Still learning.
reaction: Still learning is the best sign.
Come visit. We'll walk a puddle. Lily makes crowns.

choices.label: We had a rough week, honestly.
reaction: Rough weeks happen. Even in love castles.
Bring your partner to the next puddle. We'll start fresh.

choices.label: Better since I paid attention to little things.
reaction: YES. Little things are everything.
Okay, I'm crying. Hand me a lily pad.

lines: Lily and I tried to watch a sunset. It was cloudy.
I said it was a sign that we should make our own sun.

choices.label: Did you make a sun?
reaction: We drew one. On a leaf. It's very yellow.
It's on our wall. It's the best sunset we ever had.

choices.label: Cloudy sunsets still count.
reaction: They do. The clouds blushed. It was lovely.
I took that as a sign. Obviously.
We stayed until the stars did the rest.

lines: I wrote Lily a poem. It rhymes 'love' with 'dove,' 'glove,' and 'above.'
It also rhymes 'Lily' with 'silly.' Twice.

choices.label: Read it to me.
reaction: Okay. Ahem. 'Lily, you are silly, willy-nilly...'
I stopped there. It gets worse.
Please never repeat that last line. Lily framed it anyway.

choices.label: What did she say?
reaction: She said, 'Again, but softer.' So I whispered it.
She cried. A happy cry. A poem cry.
She asked for a copy. I printed twelve, just in case.

lines: Lily gave me a pebble. Just a plain one.
I held it for an hour. Then I realized it was a sign. Of her.

choices.label: Cute.
reaction: It's not just a pebble. It's HER pebble.
I'm sleeping with it. Don't judge.
She grinned and said, 'See? Round and slightly confused.'

choices.label: What's special about it?
reaction: Nothing. That's the point. She picked it because it reminded her of me.
Round. Slightly confused. Perfect.
She keeps one for me too. We trade on Fridays.

lines: We had a fight about whose turn it was to pick the lily pad.
I said 'it's a sign we need a bigger pad.' We both laughed.

choices.label: Problem solved.
reaction: A bigger pad. Obviously.
Now there's room for two. And a snack. And an argument. All good.
I measured the pad twice. Lily just stood on it.

choices.label: Fights can be funny.
reaction: Sometimes. The key is to look for the funny.
If the pad sinks, we laugh. Same energy.
The new pad is lopsided. We call it 'ours.'

lines: I tried to sing Lily a serenade. A frog sings by default. It was… loud.
The neighbors clapped. Politely. Through their windows.

choices.label: A loud serenade is a good serenade.
reaction: Thank you! Volume is love. That's my motto.
Lily said she heard it from three tunnels away. She was smiling.

choices.label: Did she join in?
reaction: She did. We were awful. It was perfect.
The neighbors are now asking for an encore.
We were awful, but the lilies seemed to sway along.

lines: I forgot to bring flowers on our date. So I handed her a leaf.
She said 'it's perfect.' I think she meant it. Her eyes were doing the thing.

choices.label: Leaves are romantic.
reaction: They're green. They're free. They're honest.
She pressed it in a book. I'm so happy I'm dizzy.
Next time I'll bring a leaf and a tiny speech.

choices.label: What thing?
reaction: The shiny thing. The 'I love you' shine.
Can't explain it. Just look for it in your partner.

lines: Lily and I decided to try silence for an hour. Together. No talking.
We lasted twelve minutes. Then I whispered 'sign.' She giggled.

choices.label: Twelve minutes is great.
reaction: It's a record. We're framing the hour glass.
Silence with Lily feels like warm water.
We're aiming for twenty minutes next time. Wish us luck.

choices.label: What was the sign?
reaction: A beetle crossing our path. It looked like it was in love.
Don't ask how I know. It had a tiny tie.

lines: Lily said 'I love you' first today. For the first time.
I fell off my lily pad. I'm still wet. I'm still smiling.

choices.label: Congrats! That's huge.
reaction: It IS huge! The biggest sign of all!
I said it back four times. In a row. Just to be safe.

choices.label: Are you okay?
reaction: I'm fantastic. I'm a puddle of happiness.
I'll dry out in a week. Maybe.
I'll dry in a week. Lily says I'm adorable damp.

lines: Remember the heart puddle? It dried up.
I almost cried. Lily said 'we'll find another.' She found it. Behind the third rock.

choices.label: Another heart puddle!
reaction: It's lopsided. It's perfect. It's ours.
We named it Puddle Two. Original, I know.
We visit it on Sundays. Lily brings snacks.

choices.label: Lily's the best.
reaction: She is. She really is. I tell her every day.
Some days twice. Some days in pebbles.
Every morning I thank the universe. Sometimes the puddle too.

lines: The pebble love castle is up to eighty-four stones.
Lily added a tiny door. I added a tiny welcome mat.

choices.label: Can I visit?
reaction: Of course! Bring your partner. The door is too small, but come anyway.
We'll squeeze. Love squeezes.
Bring pebbles. We need a roof, and roofs are hard.

choices.label: That's adorable.
reaction: It's our project. Our forever project.
A castle is never finished. That's the point.
It's at eighty-four stones. Lily says ninety is the dream.

lines: You remember my four-page speech? I cut it down to two lines.
'I love you. Walk with me?' Lily said yes. Of course.

choices.label: Short and perfect.
reaction: I thought the long one was better. I was wrong.
Short is brave. Short means you mean it.

choices.label: I miss the long one.
reaction: I'll read it to you someday. With a cape.
The cape is non-negotiable.
I'll read it on our fiftieth puddle-versary.

lines: The clover crown is on its third version. Lily still wears it.
She says it's lucky. I say it's love. Same thing.

choices.label: Lucky and loved.
reaction: Both. Always both.
I might make a matching one for you. For luck.
I'd make you one too. Daisy for luck, clover for love.

choices.label: Nine hours well spent.
reaction: Eleven now. I added a daisy. It took forever.
Lily cried. A good cry. Again.
She dried the old one. It's on our wall now.

lines: Hot take: signs are made up, but they're fun.
Love is choosing the sign. Every day. On purpose.

choices.label: That's wise.
reaction: I stole it from Lily. She says it better.
But I say it with more pebbles.
Lily's version has fewer pebbles and more wisdom.

choices.label: Signs are real.
reaction: They are to me! A hug from the universe!
Don't tell Lily I said 'made up.'
I swear the universe winks sometimes. Don't tell Lily.

lines: Hot take: it's okay to be a little extra.
If someone loves you, they love the extra. Maybe even the extra extra.

choices.label: Extra is lovely.
reaction: Thank you! I'm the extra extra.
Lily says I'm her favorite kind of loud.
Lily says extra is my brand. I'm putting it on a pebble.

choices.label: Sometimes extra is tiring.
reaction: True. I know. I'm learning when to dial it down.
Lily taps my arm. Two taps. It means 'gentle, babe.'

lines: Hot take: say the mushy thing now. Not later.
Later has a way of never arriving. Ribbit.

choices.label: You're right.
reaction: I know! I'm basically a philosopher. A damp one.
Go say a mushy thing. I'll wait.
Say it softly. Say it twice. Then eat something.

choices.label: What if it's awkward?
reaction: Awkward is just honesty in a funny hat.
Wear the hat. Say it.
Awkward is the fastest road to something real.

lines: Do you and your partner have a first-date story?
I want every detail. Even the dumb ones.

choices.label: It was awkward but sweet.
reaction: Awkward but sweet is the best genre.
I'm picturing it with violins. Frog violins.
I'd love to hear every detail. Bring snacks next time.

choices.label: We got lost on the way.
reaction: Lost together is a great start.
You found each other. That's the plot.
Lost together is basically a movie.

lines: What's a sign your partner loves you? Not a big one. A tiny one.
Fenn needs tiny signs.

choices.label: They remember my coffee order.
reaction: Remembering the order is so romantic!
My heart hurts. In a good way.
Lily does that. I save every note she writes.

choices.label: They save me the last bite.
reaction: The last bite! The ultimate sacrifice!
I'd cry. Then eat it. Then cry again.
I'd frame the last bite. I'm that dramatic.

lines: If you could re-live one moment with your partner, which would it be?
I'd pick our first puddle. Obviously.

choices.label: Our first trip together.
reaction: Ooh. A first trip. I love a first trip.
Every first is a little sign.
Firsts are the loudest memories. I'd relive mine hourly.

choices.label: A random Tuesday.
reaction: A random Tuesday! That's so real.
Ordinary days are the best days. I'm writing that on a pebble.

dialogues.scene: Fenn is perfectly still, looking up at a faint beam of light through the ceiling.
lines: Do you see that? The light is hitting the pond in a perfect line.
Lily and I stood right there on our first date.
No words. No speech. I just wanted you to see it.

choices.label: It's beautiful.
reaction: It is. Thank you for seeing it with me.
Some signs are quiet. This is one.
I'll bring Lily here soon. She'll love it.

choices.label: Take a moment with Fenn.
reaction: ...Thank you. This is the best kind of silence.
I'll remember this one. Pebble and all.
We stood there a long time. It was enough.

dialogues.scene: Fenn is holding a small box, trembling slightly.
lines: Okay. Don't laugh. I made Lily a ring. Out of grass and one shiny bead.
I want to ask her to be mine forever. Not a big deal. Just forever.
What if she says no?

choices.label: She'll say yes.
reaction: You think? Okay. Okay, okay, okay.
If she says yes, I'll name a puddle after you.
If she says yes, I'll cry into the pond.

choices.label: You're brave.
reaction: Brave? I'm shaking like a leaf.
But I'm going. Wish me luck. And pebbles.
Wish me luck. And please hold the bead.
